authority_policy: Runtime version/apiReflect and original upstream outrank mirrors. Extended actions must be verified on the user's installed AnkiConnect before use.

actions.name: getEaseFactors
actions.description: Returns an array with the ease factor for each of the given cards (in the same order).

actions.name: setEaseFactors
actions.description: Sets ease factor of cards by card ID; returns `true` if successful (all cards existed) or `false` otherwise.

actions.name: setSpecificValueOfCard
actions.description: Sets specific value of a single card. Given the risk of wreaking havor in the database when changing some of the values of a card, some of the keys require the argument "warning_check" set to True. This can be used to set a card's flag, change it's ease factor, change the review order in a filtered deck and change the column "data" (not currently used by anki apparantly), and many other values. A list of values and explanation of their respective utility can be found at [AnkiDroid's wiki](https://github.com/ankidroid/Anki-Android/wiki/Database-Structure).

actions.name: suspend
actions.description: Suspend cards by card ID; returns `true` if successful (at least one card wasn't already suspended) or `false` otherwise.

actions.name: unsuspend
actions.description: Unsuspend cards by card ID; returns `true` if successful (at least one card was previously suspended) or `false` otherwise.

actions.name: suspended
actions.description: Check if card is suspended by its ID. Returns `true` if suspended, `false` otherwise.

actions.name: areSuspended
actions.description: Returns an array indicating whether each of the given cards is suspended (in the same order). If card doesn't exist returns `null`.

actions.name: areDue
actions.description: Returns an array indicating whether each of the given cards is due (in the same order). *Note*: cards in the learning queue with a large interval (over 20 minutes) are treated as not due until the time of their interval has passed, to match the way Anki treats them when reviewing.

actions.name: getIntervals
actions.description: Returns an array of the most recent intervals for each given card ID, or a 2-dimensional array of all the intervals for each given card ID when `complete` is `true`. Negative intervals are in seconds and positive intervals in days.

actions.name: findCards
actions.description: Returns an array of card IDs for a given query. Functionally identical to `guiBrowse` but doesn't use the GUI for better performance. * Optional: pass `fields` to include extra values with each card result. When `fields` is provided, the result is an array of objects that always include `cardId` and the requested fields. Currently supported field values are: `prop:r`, `prop:s`.

actions.name: cardsToNotes
actions.description: Returns an unordered array of note IDs for the given card IDs. For cards with the same note, the ID is only given once in the array.

actions.name: cardsModTime
actions.description: Returns a list of objects containings for each card ID the modification time. This function is about 15 times faster than executing `cardsInfo`.

actions.name: cardsInfo
actions.description: Returns a list of objects containing for each card ID the card fields, front and back sides including CSS, note type, the note that the card belongs to, and deck name, last modification timestamp as well as ease and interval. * Optional: pass `fields` to include extra values on each card object. Currently supported field values are: `prop:r`, `prop:s`, `prop:d`. * Optional: pass `noteFields` to only include selected note field names in the `fields` object. * Optional: pass `retrieved_info_mode`, one of:

actions.name: forgetCards
actions.description: Forget cards, making the cards new again.

actions.name: relearnCards
actions.description: Make cards be "relearning".

actions.name: answerCards
actions.description: Answer cards. Ease is between 1 (Again) and 4 (Easy). Will start the timer immediately before answering. Returns `true` if card exists, `false` otherwise.

actions.name: setDueDate
actions.description: Set Due Date. Turns cards into review cards if they are new, and makes them due on a certain date. * 0 = today * 1! = tomorrow + change interval to 1 * 3-7 = random choice of 3-7 days

actions.name: deckNames
actions.description: Gets the complete list of deck names for the current user.

actions.name: deckNamesAndIds
actions.description: Gets the complete list of deck names and their respective IDs for the current user.

actions.name: getDecks
actions.description: Accepts an array of card IDs and returns an object with each deck name as a key, and its value an array of the given cards which belong to it.

actions.name: createDeck
actions.description: Create a new empty deck. Will not overwrite a deck that exists with the same name.

actions.name: changeDeck
actions.description: Moves cards with the given IDs to a different deck, creating the deck if it doesn't exist yet.

actions.name: deleteDecks
actions.description: Deletes decks with the given names. The argument `cardsToo` *must* be specified and set to `true`.

actions.name: getDeckConfig
actions.description: Gets the configuration group object for the given deck.

actions.name: saveDeckConfig
actions.description: Saves the given configuration group, returning `true` on success or `false` if the ID of the configuration group is invalid (such as when it does not exist).

actions.name: setDeckConfigId
actions.description: Changes the configuration group for the given decks to the one with the given ID. Returns `true` on success or `false` if the given configuration group or any of the given decks do not exist.

actions.name: cloneDeckConfigId
actions.description: Creates a new configuration group with the given name, cloning from the group with the given ID, or from the default group if this is unspecified. Returns the ID of the new configuration group, or `false` if the specified group to clone from does not exist.

actions.name: removeDeckConfigId
actions.description: Removes the configuration group with the given ID, returning `true` if successful, or `false` if attempting to remove either the default configuration group (ID = 1) or a configuration group that does not exist.

actions.name: getDeckStats
actions.description: Gets statistics such as total cards and cards due for the given decks.

actions.name: guiBrowse
actions.description: Invokes the *Card Browser* dialog and searches for a given query. Returns an array of identifiers of the cards that were found. Query syntax is [documented here](https://docs.ankiweb.net/searching.html).

actions.name: guiSelectCard
actions.description: Finds the open instance of the *Card Browser* dialog and selects a card given a card identifier. Returns `true` if the *Card Browser* is open, `false` otherwise.

actions.name: guiSelectedNotes
actions.description: Finds the open instance of the *Card Browser* dialog and returns an array of identifiers of the notes that are selected. Returns an empty list if the browser is not open.

actions.name: guiAddCards
actions.description: Invokes the *Add Cards* dialog, presets the note using the given deck and model, with the provided field values and tags. Invoking it multiple times closes the old window and _reopen the window_ with the new provided values.

actions.name: guiEditNote
actions.description: Opens the *Edit* dialog with a note corresponding to given note ID. The dialog is similar to the *Edit Current* dialog, but:

actions.name: guiCurrentCard
actions.description: Returns information about the current card or `null` if not in review mode.

actions.name: guiStartCardTimer
actions.description: Starts or resets the `timerStarted` value for the current card. This is useful for deferring the start time to when it is displayed via the API, allowing the recorded time taken to answer the card to be more accurate when calling `guiAnswerCard`.

actions.name: guiShowQuestion
actions.description: Shows question text for the current card; returns `true` if in review mode or `false` otherwise.

actions.name: guiShowAnswer
actions.description: Shows answer text for the current card; returns `true` if in review mode or `false` otherwise.

actions.name: guiAnswerCard
actions.description: Answers the current card; returns `true` if succeeded or `false` otherwise. Note that the answer for the current card must be displayed before before any answer can be accepted by Anki.

actions.name: guiUndo
actions.description: Undo the last action / card; returns `true` if succeeded or `false` otherwise.

actions.name: guiDeckOverview
actions.description: Opens the *Deck Overview* dialog for the deck with the given name; returns `true` if succeeded or `false` otherwise.

actions.name: guiDeckBrowser
actions.description: Opens the *Deck Browser* dialog.

actions.name: guiDeckReview
actions.description: Starts review for the deck with the given name; returns `true` if succeeded or `false` otherwise.

actions.name: guiImportFile
actions.description: Invokes the *Import... (Ctrl+Shift+I)* dialog with an optional file path. Brings up the dialog for user to review the import. Supports all file types that Anki supports. Brings open file dialog if no path is provided. Forward slashes must be used in the path on Windows. Only supported for Anki 2.1.52+.

actions.name: guiExitAnki
actions.description: Schedules a request to gracefully close Anki. This operation is asynchronous, so it will return immediately and won't wait until the Anki process actually terminates.

actions.name: guiCheckDatabase
actions.description: Requests a database check, but returns immediately without waiting for the check to complete. Therefore, the action will always return `true` even if errors are detected during the database check.

actions.name: storeMediaFile
actions.description: Stores a file with the specified base64-encoded contents inside the media folder. Alternatively you can specify a absolute file path, or a url from where the file shell be downloaded. If more than one of `data`, `path` and `url` are provided, the `data` field will be used first, then `path`, and finally `url`. To prevent Anki from removing files not used by any cards (e.g. for configuration files), prefix the filename with an underscore. These files are still synchronized to AnkiWeb. Any existing file with the same name is deleted by default. Set `deleteExisting` to false to prevent that
actions.source_signature: self, filename, data=None, path=None, url=None, skipHash=None, deleteExisting=True

actions.name: retrieveMediaFile
actions.description: Retrieves the base64-encoded contents of the specified file, returning `false` if the file does not exist.

actions.name: getMediaFilesNames
actions.description: Gets the names of media files matched the pattern. Returning all names by default.

actions.name: getMediaDirPath
actions.description: Gets the full path to the `collection.media` folder of the currently opened profile.

actions.name: deleteMediaFile
actions.description: Deletes the specified file inside the media folder.

actions.name: requestPermission
actions.description: Requests permission to use the API exposed by this plugin. This method does not require the API key, and is the only one that accepts requests from any origin; the other methods only accept requests from trusted origins, which are listed under `webCorsOriginList` in the add-on config. `localhost` is trusted by default.

actions.name: version
actions.description: Gets the version of the API exposed by this plugin. Currently versions `1` through `6` are defined.

actions.name: apiReflect
actions.description: Gets information about the AnkiConnect APIs available. The request supports the following params:

actions.name: sync
actions.description: Synchronizes the local Anki collections with AnkiWeb.

actions.name: getProfiles
actions.description: Retrieve the list of profiles.

actions.name: getActiveProfile
actions.description: Retrieve the active profile.

actions.name: loadProfile
actions.description: Selects the profile specified in request.

actions.name: multi
actions.description: Performs multiple actions in one request, returning an array with the response of each action (in the given order).

actions.name: exportPackage
actions.description: Exports a given deck in `.apkg` format. Returns `true` if successful or `false` otherwise. The optional property `includeSched` (default is `false`) can be specified to include the cards' scheduling data.

actions.name: importPackage
actions.description: Imports a file in `.apkg` format into the collection. Returns `true` if successful or `false` otherwise. Note that the file path is relative to Anki's collection.media folder, not to the client.

actions.name: reloadCollection
actions.description: Tells anki to reload all data from the database.

actions.name: modelNames
actions.description: Gets the complete list of model names for the current user.

actions.name: modelNamesAndIds
actions.description: Gets the complete list of model names and their corresponding IDs for the current user.

actions.name: findModelsById
actions.description: Gets a list of models for the provided model IDs from the current user.

actions.name: findModelsByName
actions.description: Gets a list of models for the provided model names from the current user.

actions.name: modelFieldNames
actions.description: Gets the complete list of field names for the provided model name.

actions.name: modelFieldDescriptions
actions.description: Gets the complete list of field descriptions (the text seen in the gui editor when a field is empty) for the provided model name.

actions.name: modelFieldFonts
actions.description: Gets the complete list of fonts along with their font sizes.

actions.name: modelFieldsOnTemplates
actions.description: Returns an object indicating the fields on the question and answer side of each card template for the given model name. The question side is given first in each array.

actions.name: createModel
actions.description: Creates a new model to be used in Anki. User must provide the `modelName`, `inOrderFields` and `cardTemplates` to be used in the model. There are optional fields `css` and `isCloze`. If not specified, `css` will use the default Anki css and `isCloze` will be equal to `false`. If `isCloze` is `true` then model will be created as Cloze.
actions.source_signature: self, modelName, inOrderFields, cardTemplates, css = None, isCloze = False

actions.name: modelTemplates
actions.description: Returns an object indicating the template content for each card connected to the provided model by name.

actions.name: modelStyling
actions.description: Gets the CSS styling for the provided model by name.

actions.name: updateModelTemplates
actions.description: Modify the templates of an existing model by name. Only specifies cards and specified sides will be modified. If an existing card or side is not included in the request, it will be left unchanged.

actions.name: updateModelStyling
actions.description: Modify the CSS styling of an existing model by name.

actions.name: findAndReplaceInModels
actions.description: Find and replace string in existing model by model name. Customise to replace in front, back or css by setting to true/false.
actions.source_signature: self, modelName, findText, replaceText, front=True, back=True, css=True

actions.name: modelTemplateRename
actions.description: Renames a template in an existing model.

actions.name: modelTemplateReposition
actions.description: Repositions a template in an existing model.

actions.name: modelTemplateAdd
actions.description: Adds a template to an existing model by name. If you want to update an existing template, use `updateModelTemplates`.

actions.name: modelTemplateRemove
actions.description: Removes a template from an existing model.

actions.name: modelFieldRename
actions.description: Rename the field name of a given model.

actions.name: modelFieldReposition
actions.description: Reposition the field within the field list of a given model.

actions.name: modelFieldAdd
actions.description: Creates a new field within a given model.

actions.name: modelFieldRemove
actions.description: Deletes a field within a given model.

actions.name: modelFieldSetFont
actions.description: Sets the font for a field within a given model.

actions.name: modelFieldSetFontSize
actions.description: Sets the font size for a field within a given model.

actions.name: modelFieldSetDescription
actions.description: Sets the description (the text seen in the gui editor when a field is empty) for a field within a given model.

actions.name: addNote
actions.description: Creates a note using the given deck and model, with the provided field values and tags. Returns the identifier of the created note created on success, and `null` on failure.

actions.name: addNotes
actions.description: Creates multiple notes using the given deck and model, with the provided field values and tags. Returns an array of identifiers of the created notes. In the event of any errors, all errors are gathered and returned. * Please see the documentation for `addNote` for an explanation of objects in the `notes` array.

actions.name: canAddNotes
actions.description: Accepts an array of objects which define parameters for candidate notes (see `addNote`) and returns an array of booleans indicating whether or not the parameters at the corresponding index could be used to create a new note.

actions.name: canAddNotesWithErrorDetail
actions.description: Accepts an array of objects which define parameters for candidate notes (see `addNote`) and returns an array of objects with fields `canAdd` and `error`.

actions.name: updateNoteFields
actions.description: Modify the fields of an existing note. You can also include audio, video, or picture files which will be added to the note with an optional `audio`, `video`, or `picture` property. Please see the documentation for `addNote` for an explanation of objects in the `audio`, `video`, or `picture` array.

actions.name: updateNote
actions.description: Modify the fields and/or tags of an existing note. In other words, combines `updateNoteFields` and `updateNoteTags`. Please see their documentation for an explanation of all properties.

actions.name: updateNoteModel
actions.description: Update the model, fields, and tags of an existing note. This allows you to change the note's model, update its fields with new content, and set new tags.

actions.name: updateNoteTags
actions.description: Set a note's tags by note ID. Old tags will be removed.

actions.name: getNoteTags
actions.description: Get a note's tags by note ID.

actions.name: addTags
actions.description: Adds tags to notes by note ID.

actions.name: removeTags
actions.description: Remove tags from notes by note ID.

actions.name: getTags
actions.description: Gets the complete list of tags for the current user.

actions.name: clearUnusedTags
actions.description: Clears all the unused tags in the notes for the current user.

actions.name: replaceTags
actions.description: Replace tags in notes by note ID.

actions.name: replaceTagsInAllNotes
actions.description: Replace tags in all the notes for the current user.

actions.name: findNotes
actions.description: Returns an array of note IDs for a given query. Query syntax is [documented here](https://docs.ankiweb.net/searching.html).

actions.name: notesInfo
actions.description: Returns a list of objects containing for each note ID the note fields, tags, note type, modification time,the cards belonging to the note and the profile where the note was created.

actions.name: notesModTime
actions.description: Returns a list of objects containings for each note ID the modification time.

actions.name: deleteNotes
actions.description: Deletes notes with the given ids. If a note has several cards associated with it, all associated cards will be deleted.

actions.name: removeEmptyNotes
actions.description: Removes all the empty notes for the current user.

actions.name: getNumCardsReviewedToday
actions.description: Gets the count of cards that have been reviewed in the current day (with day start time as configured by user in anki)

actions.name: getNumCardsReviewedByDay
actions.description: Gets the number of cards reviewed as a list of pairs of `(dateString, number)`

actions.name: getCollectionStatsHTML
actions.description: Gets the collection statistics report

actions.name: cardReviews
actions.description: Requests all card reviews for a specified deck after a certain time. `startID` is the latest unix time not included in the result. Returns a list of 9-tuples `(reviewTime, cardID, usn, buttonPressed, newInterval, previousInterval, newFactor, reviewDuration, reviewType)`

actions.name: getReviewsOfCards
actions.description: Requests all card reviews for each card ID. Returns a dictionary mapping each card ID to a list of dictionaries of the format:

actions.name: getLatestReviewID
actions.description: Returns the unix time of the latest review for the given deck. 0 if no review has ever been made for the deck.

actions.name: insertReviews
actions.description: Inserts the given reviews into the database. Required format: list of 9-tuples `(reviewTime, cardID, usn, buttonPressed, newInterval, previousInterval, newFactor, reviewDuration, reviewType)`

actions.name: gradeNow
actions.description: Grades cards immediately using the same rating scale as review answers. `ease` must be between 1 (Again) and 4 (Easy). Returns `true` when the operation succeeds.

actions.name: repositionNewCards
actions.description: Repositions eligible new cards using Anki native reposition logic while preserving caller order. * `orderedCardIds` must be a non-empty list of integers. * Duplicates are removed by card ID only (first occurrence kept). * Cards that do not exist are reported in `skippedNotFound`. * Cards that exist but are not currently `is:new` are reported in `skippedNotNew`.

actions.name: guiAddNoteSetData
actions.description: Sets fields, tags, deck, and note type (model) in the *Add Note* dialog. Optionally appends to fields/tags instead of replacing them. - If the Add Note dialog is not open, returns an error. - Setting deck/model always replaces the current value. - Setting fields/tags appends if `append` is true, otherwise replaces. - Also supports importing media (images/audio) via the note object.

actions.name: guiPlayAudio
actions.description: Plays any Audio for the current side of the current card; returns `true` if succeeded or `false` otherwise.
